proposals.evidence: DEDR5264 explicitly gives Irula bärī and Alu Kurumba bari thatched roof, with Toda pary roof. Survey neighbouring Badaga bari roof compares with the attested Nilgiri roof noun in the bind/cover family. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1578 gives Tamil kiẓaṅku esculent/bulbous root, explicitly including potato, and Kannada geṇasu/geẓasu, Tulu kereṅg- and related tuber names. These bare survey kaŋgɨ/kalaŋgɨ/gelusum/ghāśu potato responses compare with that root/tuber family. Botanical application to potato is retained, without equating potato and yam as species. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR273 explicitly gives Kota av and Toda af/afuf mother, alongside Kannada avva. Survey Badaga həvvə, Kota au and Toda avopʰ mother preserve corresponding Nilgiri maternal forms and their source labial/aspirated notation. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1873 explicitly gives Kannada kūsu infant/babe and Toda kūx girl/daughter. Survey Irula kusu, Badaga kūśu and Sholaga kōcu child compare with the Nilgiri/southern infant noun; the questioned Gondi aunt comparison is not used. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2596 gives Tamil ciṉṉam gold coin, Kota cinm gold, Toda sin gold/ear-ring and Kannada/Tulu cinna gold. Survey Nilgiri/southern cinnā/śinnā/sīnnā/sinum forms retain this specific gold noun, including Kota final nasal expansion; no connection to the homonymous small adjective is proposed. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
